purpose: timed live smoke (exactly 200 files) over the Consultant export; supplies measured throughput, terminal counts, max observed candidate load, hashes, and the T03 driver/timeout policy. Diagnostic only: no numeric bound is selected here (runtime_stop persists).

corpus.selection: first 200 files in scanner walk order (--limit 200)
corpus.sample_note: walk-order prefix sample; observed avg size is within ~2% of the full-corpus mean (3.7 GB / 43,785 files), so the time-based projection is treated as order-of-magnitude with a 4x safety factor

smoke_run.stderr_terminal_counts: npa-bounds-scan: files_attempted=200 files_decoded=200 malformed=0 unreadable=0 blocks=18747 candidates=7582

max_observed_load.note: max fields of the closed per-metric records (count/min/max/histogram); direct metrics separated from namespaced proxy_* metrics

derived_rates.basis: wall_ms_measured=4426 over exactly 200 files; derived via python (gsd_exec af245efa)

progress_probe.conclusion: periodic atomic rewrite + heartbeat overhead is within run-to-run noise at N=10 over 200 files; at the full corpus with N=500 the rewrite cost stays negligible

driver_policy_for_t03.driver: exactly one release-mode run launched as a single background process (async launch; stdout+stderr redirected under git-ignored target/), because the projected wall (16.1 min) exceeds the 10-minute gsd_exec invocation cap
driver_policy_for_t03.progress_flag: --progress 500 (heartbeats every ~11 s; ~88 atomic partial rewrites of the tracked --out JSONL over the full corpus)
driver_policy_for_t03.hard_timeout_rationale: 3.7x the 969 s projection; covers a 2x corpus-heterogeneity slowdown with margin
driver_policy_for_t03.interruption_contract: on kill/abort the --out JSONL remains a valid closed-schema run_status:"incomplete" diagnostic (ended_at:null, atomic tmp+rename, no torn file); reconcile via re-run, never hand-edit
supervision_checks: exit code is checked alongside the terminal manifest counts (never exit code alone)
success + malformed + unreadable == files_attempted reconciliation at terminal

limitations: 200-file walk-order prefix sample, not a stratified corpus sample; projection carries a 4x safety factor
npa-bounds-scan/v1 is a [proposed] scaffold (D388): numeric bounds remain deferred-undefined; this card selects no bound
NPA 916-vs-799 reconciliation is T03/T04 scope; this smoke counts documents/blocks/candidates only
manifest ended_at granularity is 1 s (RFC3339); wall_ms_measured wraps the process with nanosecond shell timestamps
raw smoke JSONLs stay under git-ignored target/; only this compact card is tracked
